title: Is godot okay for 3d games or should I switch to unity?
author: TheUniverseOrNothing
selftext:
I’ve been making a 3d climbing game with realistic mountains and 3d graphics. Godot has been great but it does lack 3d character movement. It’s not terrible but it still looks a little off. 

The overall gameplay and function work fine. And I’m enjoying playing the game. I know that solid gameplay will outperform the graphics. But while I’m having fable 5.2 and opus 5.5 doing great work with blender I’m heavily debating if I should just make the switch now?

When I discuss this with Claude it suggests that godot has more than enough 3d ability and could still get my character to that level with just a little more effort.

Any advice on this?
